# Walmart

> Walmart is a comprehensive e-commerce platform offering millions of products across departments with membership benefits, daily deals, and seasonal shopping.

Walmart.com serves as the primary digital shopping destination for Walmart customers, featuring product categories, promotional deals, membership programs like Walmart+, and order management tools. The site integrates loyalty benefits including gas savings through Exxon and Mobil partnerships, free delivery options, and exclusive member pricing.

## Key Topics

- Walmart+ membership
- Free delivery
- Gas savings
- Flash deals
- Seasonal shopping
- Product categories
- Order tracking
- Beauty & Personal Care
- Discount shopping
- Membership benefits
- Pricing plans
- Promotional offers
- Sam's Club
- OnePay CashRewards Card
- Peacock streaming

## Shopping & Discovery

- [Walmart | Save Money. Live better.](https://www.walmart.com): Walmart homepage with promotions, Walmart+ membership, and seasonal deals.
- [All Departments - Walmart.com](https://www.walmart.com/all-departments): Department directory and product category navigation for Walmart.com.
- [Flash Deals - Walmart.com](https://www.walmart.com/shop/deals/flash-deals): Limited-time flash deals and daily discount offers at Walmart.
- [Beauty & Personal Care Deals - Walmart.com](https://www.walmart.com/shop/deals/beauty-and-personal-care): Beauty and personal care deals including skincare and grooming products.

## Membership & Benefits

- [Walmart+ Membership | Start Your 30-Day Trial](https://www.walmart.com/plus): Walmart+ membership page with benefits, free delivery, and gas savings.

## Seasonal & Promotional Shopping

- [Easter: Candy, Baskets, Eggs, and Decorations | Walmart.com](https://www.walmart.com/cp/easter/1102349): Easter seasonal shopping with candy, baskets, eggs, and decorations.

## Account & Order Management

- [Manage Account - Track your order - Walmart.com](https://www.walmart.com/orders): Order tracking and account management for Walmart customers.
